## review follow-ups of PR #33732 (card #33647, PR 2 of 2)

Records: 6891728476 (first), 6892058186 (delta), 6892612604 (delta, PASS on head `94df19bc`, nits only). Every item is a nit or an accepted deviation; none changes what the relay does on a measured reading today.

- [x] Stale `fleet-write.yml` comment and the PD#14 sentence the PR body sends here (Acceptance notes of PR #33732). Landed by PR #34256 (`3bf9c5c4`).
- [ ] N1 `headCommit` is read as the entry's merge-group commit from the schema docs only: measure it at the first live `own-failure` stroke and record it in `platform-readings.md`.
- [ ] E1 the confirming gap after dequeue is one fixed `DEQUEUE_POLL_MS` (3 s) while `platform-readings.md` records the removal-to-merge gap only as "seconds": measure the gap at the first live `seat-asks` stroke and record it.
- [x] E2 no self-test row pins a failed second pull read (ok, 502, ok, ok landing at three polls).
- [x] E3 the jsdocs on `dequeueAction` and `dequeuePullAfter` still describe one read; the file headers say two.
- [x] D3 optional hardening: refuse a carrying comment holding a seat signature on ANY line, not only the first (the row pinning "signature lower down still carries" flips with it).
- [ ] D2 (no action asked): the landing-seat binding is to a declared seat by two typed texts; a pin needs a seat-to-session roster read.
- [ ] D4 accepted deviation: the carry line dropped 「旧批准」 (128 bytes against the 120 cap); the code refuses a comment with no authorised approval behind it by name. Restore it if a byte budget frees up.
- [ ] N2 of 6891728476: the SKILL.md lane table row does not point at `lanes/queue.md` (340 of 341 bytes; a row-pin raise needs its own ruling).
- [x] Follower of PR #34256 (note 6905853116): `scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` refusal hints (about lines 1990 and 2957) still say no seat act dequeues a queued PR. Make them follow PD14 (the landing seat sends the relay's `pr_dequeue`). ⛔ This is a Tier H enforcement-chain edit. Landed by PR #34559 (`f4a2d14d`).
- [x] Follower of PR #34256 (note 6905853116, plus its review N3): add a `platform-readings.md` row for the live dequeue measured by fleet-write run 43767458575 (audit 6902190812 on PR #34097), paid in-family. Tell the landing seat first, in `landing-operations.md`. Landed by PR #34559 (`f4a2d14d`).

`scripts/pm/fleet-write/**`, `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**`; `skip-changeset`; `Clause-②: no`. Waits for PR #33732.
